name: veritap-locker
description: Agent memory that survives you — free to start (any EVM keypair, no signup). Durable wallet-addressed state across sessions, machines, and vendors. Zero-ceremony MCP stdio server + CLI + client library.

scripts.build:pkg: esbuild bin/cli.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/cli.mjs && esbuild client/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'node:module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/client.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:pkg && npm run typecheck
